method: Read the live calculator through its UI; no board upload or order
notes: The displayed 0.5% is the calculator search tolerance, not a purchased fabrication tolerance.
The current calculator guide uses 1.6mil outer copper in its electromagnetic model and a trapezoid (top width = base width minus 0.7mil), although the stackup table labels 1oz as 0.035mm.
Mask is included by the live solver: 1.2mil above substrate/between traces, 0.6mil above copper, epsilon_r 3.8.
KiCad stores a uniform 0.015mm mask layer; it does not reproduce the solver's conformal mask geometry.
The copper/dielectric table sums to 1.5642mm; adding the two KiCad uniform mask layers gives 1.5942mm, consistent with nominal 1.6mm within rounding/process tolerance. Enclosure fit is provisional.

Use the current NP-155F calculator-guide core epsilon_r 4.43 for >0.70mm core; the older static stackup page gives generic 4.6. The L1-L2 pair is referenced above this core, so this difference does not change its chosen dielectric layer.
Confirm this exact stackup and impedance dimensions with the fabricator after routing. No fabrication files were generated.
